G01: Equal present profile groups per real coverage region; sample weighted inside each profile
G02: Mean covered repeated slots per physical client; original dataset mass once per client
G03: Equal present physical capability tiers [0,40),[40,70),[70,100); sample-slot weighting inside each tier
G04: G01 only in the STATIC all-seven-model common region
G05: G01 only outside the STATIC all-seven-model common region
G06: Equal covered slots, no sample weighting
G07: Native anchored learning delta times clip(sqrt(mean(all region cumulative unique-client counts)/own count),.8,1.2); counters include round1
G08: Global Native update rescaled to same-input virtual G07 full update norm; own cumulative counters
G09: Cluster repeated slots by physical client with Native slot masses; unbiased weighted cross-client dispersion estimates mean noise N; shrink gain max(norm(mean)^2-N,0)/(max(norm(mean)^2-N,0)+N); no noise -> Native, one physical client -> Native
G10: Global Native update rescaled to same-input virtual G09 full update norm
failure: Preserve failed logs/checkpoints; finish the other independent job in that batch, then stop later batches. No automatic retry or parameter change.
no_extensions: Exactly ten new runs; no baseline rerun, other seed, scores, memory or combinations
